title: On transversality in flag manifolds and linearity of amalgams
summary: We show that the fundamental group of the double of a complete negatively curved locally symmetric manifold along a closed geodesic is linear. More generally, we establish linearity of doubles of torsion-free transverse subgroups (also known in the literature as regular antipodal subgroups) of semisimple Lie groups along biproximal maximal cyclic subgroups.
